        "contents": "        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[tokio::main]\nasync fn main() -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    // Initialize tracing\n    tracing_subscriber::fmt()\n        .with_env_filter(\n            tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::new(\"info\")),\n        )\n        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n        .init();\n\n    info!(\"🚀 Starting Gemini CLI MCP Server v0.48.0\");\n    info!(\"   OAuth 2.0 authentication (no API key required)\");\n    info!(\"   Listening on STDIO...\");\n\n    let stdin = std::io::stdin();\n    let mut stdout = std::io::stdout();\n\n    // Process messages line by line\n    for line in stdin.lock().lines() {\n        let line = line.context(\"Failed to read line from stdin\")?;\n\n        if line.trim().is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        debug!(\"📥 Received: {}\", line);\n\n        // Parse JSON-RPC message\n        let message: JSONRPCMessage = match serde_json::from_str(&amp;line) {\n            Ok(msg) =&gt; msg,\n            Err(e) =&gt; {\n                error!(\"❌ Failed to parse message: {}\", e);\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Process request\n        if let Some(response) = process_request(message).await {\n            let response_json = serde_json::to_string(&amp;response)?;\n            debug!(\"📤 Sending: {}\", response_json);\n            writeln!(stdout, \"{}\", response_json)?;\n            stdout.flush()?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    info!(\"👋 Gemini CLI MCP Server shutting down\");\n    Ok(())\n}",

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[tokio::main]\nasync fn main() -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    // Initialize tracing\n    tracing_subscriber::fmt()\n        .with_env_filter(\n            tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::new(\"info\")),\n        )\n        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n        .init();\n\n    info!(\"🚀 Starting Gemini CLI MCP Server v0.48.0\");\n    info!(\"   OAuth 2.0 authentication (no API key required)\");\n    info!(\"   Listening on STDIO...\");\n\n    let stdin = std::io::stdin();\n    let mut stdout = std::io::stdout();\n\n    // Process messages line by line\n    for line in stdin.lock().lines() {\n        let line = line.context(\"Failed to read line from stdin\")?;\n\n        if line.trim().is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        debug!(\"📥 Received: {}\", line);\n\n        // Parse JSON-RPC message\n        let message: JSONRPCMessage = match serde_json::from_str(&amp;line) {\n            Ok(msg) =&gt; msg,\n            Err(e) =&gt; {\n                error!(\"❌ Failed to parse message: {}\", e);\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Process request\n        if let Some(response) = process_request(message).await {\n            let response_json = serde_json::to_string(&amp;response)?;\n            debug!(\"📤 Sending: {}\", response_json);\n            writeln!(stdout, \"{}\", response_json)?;\n            stdout.flush()?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    info!(\"👋 Gemini CLI MCP Server shutting down\");\n    Ok(())\n}",

        "contents": "export class DualBridge extends EventEmitter {\nprivate handleError(message: BridgeMessage) {\n\n  }\n\n  async executeCommand(command: string, args: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {}): Promise&lt;{ exitCode: number; stdout: string; stderr: string }&gt; {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      const messageId = this.sendMessage({\n        type: BridgeMessageType.COMMAND_EXEC,\n        payload: { command, args },\n        target: 'cli'\n      })\n\n      const responseHandler = (result: { messageId?: string; exitCode?: number; stdout?: string; stderr?: string }) =&gt; {\n        if (result.messageId === messageId) {\n          this.off('commandResult', responseHandler)\n          resolve({\n            exitCode: result.exitCode ?? 0,\n            stdout: result.stdout ??         "contents": "export function CodexProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n\n\n  const runWebResearch = async (query: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const result = await apiClient.runWebResearch({ query });\n      dispatch({ type: 'ADD_WEB_RESEARCH_RESULT', payload: result });\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Web research failed:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeCommand = async (command: string, cwd?: string) =&gt; {\n    const bridge = cliBridgeRef.current;\n\n    if (bridge) {\n      try {\n        if (!state.cliBridgeConnected) {\n          await bridge.connect();\n        }\n\n        return await bridge.executeCommand(command, { cwd });\n      } catch (bridgeError) {\n        console.warn('CLI bridge execution failed, falling back to API client:', bridgeError);\n      }\n    }\n\n    try {\n      return await apiClient.executeCommand(command.split(' '), cwd);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Command execution failed:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadMetrics = async () =&gt;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "# Codex GUI Service\n\nThis crate exposes a lightweight HTTP service that translates curated UI actions into Codex CLI invocations.\nIt powers the web front-end located in &#96;gui/frontend&#96;.\n\n## Running locally\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Start the HTTP service\ncd codex-rs\ncargo run -p codex-gui\n\n# Optional: override settings\n# CODEX_GUI_PORT=8080 CODEX_GUI_CLI_PATH=./target/debug/codex cargo run -p codex-gui\n\n# 2. Start the front-end\ncd ../gui/frontend\npnpm install\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe front-end expects the backend at &#96;http://localhost:8787&#96; by default.\nSet &#96;VITE_API_URL&#96; when running &#96;pnpm dev&#96; if you customize the port.\n\n## API\n\n- &#96;GET /api/actions&#96; – Fetches metadata about the available orchestration playbooks.\n- &#96;POST /api/actions/{id}/execute&#96; – Runs the selected playbook.         "contents": "//! Webhook command for triggering external integrations.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse anyhow::bail;\nuse clap::Parser;\nuse codex_common::CliConfigOverrides;\nuse codex_core::integrations::WebhookClient;\nuse codex_core::integrations::WebhookPayload;\nuse codex_core::integrations::WebhookService;\nuse serde_json::Value;\nuse std::io::Read;\n\n/// Send webhook notifications to external services (GitHub, Slack, Custom)\n#[derive(Debug, Parser)]\npub struct WebhookCli {\n    #[clap(flatten)]\n    pub config_overrides: CliConfigOverrides,\n\n    #[command(subcommand)]\n    pub subcommand: WebhookSubcommand,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, clap::Subcommand)]\npub enum WebhookSubcommand {\n    /// Send a GitHub API request\n    Github(GithubArgs),\n\n    /// Send a Slack webhook notification\n    Slack(SlackArgs),\n\n    /// Send a custom webhook\n    Custom(CustomArgs),\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Parser)]\npub struct GithubArgs {\n    /// GitHub API endpoint (e.g., \"repos/owner/repo/issues\")\n    #[arg(long, short)]\n    pub endpoint: String,\n\n    /// JSON payload (or use stdin with -)\n    #[arg(long, short)]\n    pub data: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Read payload from stdin\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub stdin: bool,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Parser)]\npub struct SlackArgs {\n    /// Slack message text\n    #[arg(long, short)]\n    pub text: String,\n\n    /// Optional channel override\n    #[arg(long, short)]\n    pub channel: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Additional JSON data\n    #[arg(long, short)]\n    pub data: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Parser)]\npub struct CustomArgs {\n    /// Custom webhook URL\n    #[arg(long, short)]\n    pub url: String,\n\n    /// JSON payload (or use stdin with -)\n    #[arg(long, short)]\n    pub data: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Read payload from stdin\n    #[arg(long)]\n    pub stdin: bool,\n\n    /// Custom headers in format \"Key: Value\" (repeatable)\n    #[arg(long = \"header\", short = 'H')]\n    pub headers: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\npub async fn run(cli: WebhookCli) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt;",

        "contents": "enum Subcommand {\n    /// Run Codex non-interactively.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"e\")]\n    Exec(ExecCli),\n\n    /// Manage login.\n    Login(LoginCommand),\n\n    /// Remove stored authentication credentials.\n    Logout(LogoutCommand),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run Codex as an MCP server and manage MCP servers.\n    Mcp(McpCli),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the Codex MCP server (stdio transport).\n    McpServer,\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the app server.\n    AppServer,\n\n    /// Launch the Codex GUI web interface.\n    ///\n    /// Starts the GUI server and opens it in your default browser.\n    /// The GUI provides a modern web-based interface for managing agents,\n    /// monitoring system resources, and interacting with Codex features.\n    ///\n    /// Options:\n    ///   --port &lt;PORT&gt;     Set the port for the GUI server (default: 3000)\n    ///   --no-browser      Don't open the browser automatically\n    ///   --backend-port    Set the backend API port (default: 8787)\n    Gui(GuiCommand),\n\n    /// Generate shell completion scripts.\n    Completion(CompletionCommand),\n\n    /// Run commands within a Codex-provided sandbox.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"debug\")]\n    Sandbox(SandboxArgs),\n\n    /// Apply the latest diff produced by Codex agent as a &#96;git apply&#96; to your local working tree.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"a\")]\n    Apply(ApplyCommand),\n\n    /// Resume a previous interactive session (picker by default; use --last to continue the most recent).\n    Resume(ResumeCommand),\n\n    /// Internal: generate TypeScript protocol bindings.\n    #[clap(hide = true)]\n    GenerateTs(GenerateTsCommand),\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Browse tasks from Codex Cloud and apply changes locally.\n    #[clap(name = \"cloud\", alias = \"cloud-tasks\")]\n    Cloud(CloudTasksCli),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate task to a sub-agent.\n    Delegate(DelegateCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate tasks to multiple agents in parallel\n    #[clap(name = \"delegate-parallel\")]\n    DelegateParallel(DelegateParallelCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Natural-language pair programming orchestrated by the supervisor",

  - `network.get_logs.request`

        "contents": "# 📋 要件定義書作成完了\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-11 18:29 JST  \n**バージョン**: 1.0.0  \n**文書番号**: REQ-SPEC-001  \n**Status**: ✅ **完了**\n\n---\n\n## 📊 作成内容\n\n### 要件定義書\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;docs/REQUIREMENTS_SPECIFICATION.md&#96;\n\n**規模**: 約1,200行（大規模正式文書）\n\n---\n\n## 📝 構成\n\n### 1. プロジェクト概要\n- **背景**: OpenAI/codexの課題\n- **目的**: zapabob/codexの目標\n- **スコープ**: 対象範囲・対象外\n- **ステークホルダー**: 役割と責任\n\n### 2. システム概要\n- **システム構成図**: 全体アーキテクチャ\n- **システム境界**: 内部/外部コンポーネント\n\n### 3. 機能要件（23項目）\n\n#### サブエージェント機構（6項目）\n- **FR-SA-001**: エージェント定義（✅ 完了）\n- **FR-SA-002**: delegate コマンド（✅ 完了）\n- **FR-SA-003**: Agent Runtime（🚧 未実装）\n- **FR-SA-004**: エージェント種類（✅ 7種類定義済み）\n- **FR-SA-005**: 権限管理（🚧 設計済み）\n- **FR-SA-006**: トークンバジェット管理（🚧 設計済み）\n\n#### Deep Research機能（6項目）\n- **FR-DR-001**: research コマンド（✅ 完了）\n- **FR-DR-002**: Web検索統合（✅ DuckDuckGo完了）\n- **FR-DR-003**: 多段階探索（✅ 完了）\n- **FR-DR-004**: 矛盾検出（✅ 完了）\n- **FR-DR-005**: 引用管理（✅ 完了）\n- **FR-DR-006**: レポート生成（✅ 完了）\n\n#### 共通機能（3項目）\n- **FR-CM-001**: 対話モード統合（🚧 未実装）\n- **FR-CM-002**: MCPツール統合（🚧 部分実装）\n- **FR-CM-003**: ログ・監査（🚧 部分実装）\n\n### 4. 非機能要件\n\n#### パフォーマンス要件\n| 機能 | 目標 | 許容 |\n|------|------|------|\n| delegate起動 | &lt; 1秒 | &lt; 3秒 |\n| research（depth=1） | &lt; 5秒 | &lt; 10秒 |\n| research（depth=3） | &lt; 30秒 | &lt; 60秒 |\n\n#### 信頼性要件\n- **可用性**: 99.9%目標\n- **エラー処理**: グレースフルデグラデーション\n- **データ整合性**: トランザクション管理",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "//! Implementation log management module\n//!\n//! Manages automatic creation of implementation logs in _docs/ directory\n//! and provides startup log reading functionality with nanj-style responses\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::error;\nuse tracing::info;\n\n/// Create an implementation log using Python script\npub async fn create_implementation_log(\n    feature_name: &amp;str,\n    task_description: &amp;str,\n    implementation_details: &amp;str,\n    worktree_name: Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let script_path = find_implementation_logger_script()?;\n\n    let mut cmd = Command::new(\"py\");\n    cmd.arg(\"-3\");\n    cmd.arg(&amp;script_path);\n    cmd.arg(\"create\");\n    cmd.arg(feature_name);\n    cmd.arg(task_description);\n    cmd.arg(implementation_details);\n\n    if let Some(worktree) = worktree_name {\n        // Note: Python script will auto-detect worktree if not provided\n        // This is a placeholder for future enhancement\n        debug!(\"Worktree name: {}\", worktree);\n    }\n\n    let output = cmd\n        .output()\n        .context(\"Failed to execute implementation logger script\")?;\n\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n        error!(\"Implementation logger script failed: {}\", stderr);\n        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n            \"Failed to create implementation log: {}\",\n            stderr\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Parse JSON response to get log path\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;(&amp;stdout) {\n        if let Some(path_str) = json.get(\"path\").and_then(|p| p.as_str()) {\n            return Ok(PathBuf::from(path_str));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Fallback: construct path from feature name\n    let docs_dir = find_docs_directory()?;\n    let now = time::OffsetDateTime::now_local().unwrap_or_else(|_| time::OffsetDateTime::now_utc());\n    let date = format!(\n        \"{:04}-{:02}-{:02}\",\n        now.year(),\n        now.month()",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Codex Session Log\n\n## Overview\n- Repository: &#96;codex-main&#96;\n- Focus: Sub-Agents &amp; Deep Research requirements, documentation updates, meta-prompt creation, supporting templates\n\n## Interaction Timeline\n\n### 1. 初期要件の把握\n- ユーザーから Codex Sub-Agents &amp; Deep Research 拡張の要件定義書を提示。\n- Codex 側で要件内容を理解し、既存ドキュメントとの整合性を確認。\n\n### 2. 要件定義書の整備\n- &#96;docs/codex-subagents-deep-research.md&#96; を作成し、背景・スコープ・機能/非機能要件・アーキテクチャなどを記載。\n- ゴールや実行モードを日本語化し、サブエージェント/Deep Research の要件を詳細化。\n\n### 3. AGENTS ガイド更新\n- &#96;AGENTS.md&#96; に日本語サマリーを追加し、Sub-Agent/Deep Research 拡張の概要・ユースケース・非機能要件・導入段取りを記載。\n- 追加で関連ドキュメントや事前確認項目を追記。\n\n### 4. 元要件の再構築\n- コードレビュー観点や実運用での本番実装に向けた手順について助言。\n- Deep Research ベストプラクティスと AI エージェント設計のポイントを整理。\n\n### 5. メタプロンプト文書の作成\n- &#96;_docs/meta-prompt-codex-subagents-deep-research.md&#96; を新規作成。\n- ゴール、実行モード、役割、ルール、入力/出力契約、サブエージェント宣言テンプレ、オーケストレーション手順、Deep Research 詳細、CLI例、フォールバック、成果物スキーマ、最終指示まで網羅。\n- 付録として &#96;defineAgent()&#96; サンプルと PR 要約テンプレを追加。\n\n### 6. 成果物テンプレート整備\n- 成果物スキーマにレポート品質指標や PR 情報フォーマットを定義。\n- PR 要約テンプレに Summary/Risk &amp; Rollback/Tests/Links セクションを追加。\n\n### 7. 追加指示への対応\n- 出典厳格化や決定ログ保存、人間レビューに配慮した出力形式、安全運用の強化など、最終指示を反映。\n\n### 8. その他\n- SDK からの &#96;defineAgent()&#96; 呼び出し例を追加。",

        "contents": "def main():\n    \"\"\"メイン関数\"\"\"\n    if len(sys.argv) &lt; 2:\n        print(\"使用方法:\")\n        print(\"  python implementation_logger.py create &lt;機能名&gt; &lt;タスク説明&gt; [実装詳細]\")\n        print(\"  python implementation_logger.py load [件数]\")\n        print(\"  python implementation_logger.py nanj\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n    \n    command = sys.argv[1]\n    \n    if command == \"create\":\n        if len(sys.argv) &lt; 4:\n            print(\"エラー: 機能名とタスク説明が必要です\", file=sys.stderr)\n            sys.exit(1)\n        \n        feature_name = sys.argv[2]\n        task_description = sys.argv[3]\n        implementation_details = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) &gt; 4 else \"実装完了\"\n        \n        log_path = create_implementation_log(\n            feature_name,\n            task_description,\n            implementation_details\n        )\n        print(json.dumps({\"status\": \"success\", \"path\": str(log_path)}))\n    \n    elif command == \"load\":\n        limit = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) &gt; 2 else 5\n        logs = load_recent_implementation_logs(limit)\n        print(json.dumps(logs, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n    \n    elif command == \"nanj\":\n        logs = load_recent_implementation_logs(5)\n        response = generate_nanj_response(logs)\n        print(response)\n    \n    else:\n        print(f\"エラー: 不明なコマンド: {command}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        sys.exit(1)\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()",

        "contents": "# ClaudeCode風自律オーケストレーター実装ログ\n\n**実施日時**: 2025-10-14 10:32 JST  \n**担当**: Codex AI エージェント  \n**対象範囲**: &#96;codex-supervisor&#96; クレート / Orchestrator Runtime / 要件ドキュメント同期\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 変更サマリ\n- &#96;AutonomousOrchestrator&#96; に **タスクレジストリ + イベントログ** を追加し、衝突検知と進行モニタリングを ClaudeCode 同等レベルまで拡張。\n- コンフリクト時にフォールバック採用や待機リトライを記録し、Supervisor 計画呼び出しもログへ可視化。\n- 実行結果に &#96;task_status&#96; / &#96;task_log&#96; / &#96;conflict_prevented&#96; フィールドを追加し、CLI・IDE・Slack 各面から状態照会できるように公開 API を整備。\n- &#96;docs/codex-subagents-deep-research.md&#96; および &#96;docs/codex-subagents-deep-research-implementation-plan.md&#96; をアップデートし、Runtime ワークストリームの要件を最新実装に同期。\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 技術詳細メモ\n1. **タスクレジストリ構築**  \n   - &#96;TaskRecord&#96; / &#96;TaskStatus&#96; / &#96;TaskLogEntry&#96; を新設し、オーケストレーター内部でタスクごとの状態遷移とタイムスタンプを保持。  \n   - イベントは &#96;VecDeque&#96; で最大 200 件まで保持し、サーフェスから &#96;recent_events()&#96; で取得可能。\n\n2. **コンフリクト回避ロジック強化**  \n   - 推奨エージェントがビジーの場合は待機 → フォールバック選定をイベントとして記録。  \n   - 待機回数やフォールバック使用状況を &#96;conflict_prevented&#96; で返し、三人体制のペアプロでも衝突が可視化されるようにした。\n\n3. **結果オブジェクト拡張**  \n   - &#96;AutonomousOrchestrationResult&#96; にタスクログや状態を同梱し、後続処理 (通知・UI) が追加情報を取得できるように更新。",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# ClaudeCode風自律オーケストレーター実装ログ\n\n**実施日時**: 2025-10-14 10:32 JST  \n**担当**: Codex AI エージェント  \n**対象範囲**: &#96;codex-supervisor&#96; クレート / Orchestrator Runtime / 要件ドキュメント同期\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 変更サマリ\n- &#96;AutonomousOrchestrator&#96; に **タスクレジストリ + イベントログ** を追加し、衝突検知と進行モニタリングを ClaudeCode 同等レベルまで拡張。\n- コンフリクト時にフォールバック採用や待機リトライを記録し、Supervisor 計画呼び出しもログへ可視化。\n- 実行結果に &#96;task_status&#96; / &#96;task_log&#96; / &#96;conflict_prevented&#96; フィールドを追加し、CLI・IDE・Slack 各面から状態照会できるように公開 API を整備。\n- &#96;docs/codex-subagents-deep-research.md&#96; および &#96;docs/codex-subagents-deep-research-implementation-plan.md&#96; をアップデートし、Runtime ワークストリームの要件を最新実装に同期。\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 技術詳細メモ\n1. **タスクレジストリ構築**  \n   - &#96;TaskRecord&#96; / &#96;TaskStatus&#96; / &#96;TaskLogEntry&#96; を新設し、オーケストレーター内部でタスクごとの状態遷移とタイムスタンプを保持。  \n   - イベントは &#96;VecDeque&#96; で最大 200 件まで保持し、サーフェスから &#96;recent_events()&#96; で取得可能。\n\n2. **コンフリクト回避ロジック強化**  \n   - 推奨エージェントがビジーの場合は待機 → フォールバック選定をイベントとして記録。  \n   - 待機回数やフォールバック使用状況を &#96;conflict_prevented&#96; で返し、三人体制のペアプロでも衝突が可視化されるようにした。\n\n3. **結果オブジェクト拡張**  \n   - &#96;AutonomousOrchestrationResult&#96; にタスクログや状態を同梱し、後続処理 (通知・UI) が追加情報を取得できるように更新。",

        "contents": "# 🚀 実装ログ自動生成スクリプト\n# Usage: .\\scripts\\new-implementation-log.ps1 \"機能名\"\n\nparam(\n    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]\n    [string]$FeatureName\n)\n\n$Date = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n$Time = Get-Date -Format \"HH:mm\"\n$Version = Get-Content -Path \"VERSION\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\nif (-not $Version) {\n    $Version = \"0.47.0-alpha.1\"\n}\n\n$FileName = \"_docs/${Date}_${FeatureName}.md\"\n\n$Template = @\"\n# 🚀 ${FeatureName} 実装完了\n\n**実装日時**: ${Date} ${Time} JST  \n**バージョン**: ${Version}  \n**Status**: 🚧 進行中\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装内容\n\n### 目的\n[なぜこの機能を実装したか]\n\n### 変更ファイル\n- &#96;&#96;path/to/file.rs&#96;&#96;\n\n### 主な変更点\n1. [変更1]\n2. [変更2]\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 完了条件チェック\n\n- [ ] 実装完了\n- [ ] テスト追加\n- [ ] ドキュメント更新\n- [ ] Clippy通過\n- [ ] ビルド成功\n\n---\n\n## 🧪 テスト結果\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncargo test -p codex-xxx\n# 結果を貼り付け\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📝 コミット情報\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit log --oneline -1\n# コミットハッシュとメッセージ\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 💡 今後の課題\n\n- [課題1]\n- [課題2]\n\n---\n\n**END OF IMPLEMENTATION LOG**\n\"@\n\n# ファイル作成\nSet-Content -Path $FileName -Value $Template -Encoding UTF8\n\nWrite-Host \"✅ Created: $FileName\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"次のステップ:\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"  1. エディタで $FileName を開く\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  2. [実装内容] セクションを記入\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  3. テスト結果を貼り付け\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  4. コミット情報を追加\" -ForegroundColor Yellow",

        "contents": "# 🚀 実装ログ自動生成スクリプト\n# Usage: .\\scripts\\new-implementation-log.ps1 \"機能名\"\n\nparam(\n    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]\n    [string]$FeatureName\n)\n\n$Date = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n$Time = Get-Date -Format \"HH:mm\"\n$Version = Get-Content -Path \"VERSION\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\nif (-not $Version) {\n    $Version = \"0.47.0-alpha.1\"\n}\n\n$FileName = \"_docs/${Date}_${FeatureName}.md\"\n\n$Template = @\"\n# 🚀 ${FeatureName} 実装完了\n\n**実装日時**: ${Date} ${Time} JST  \n**バージョン**: ${Version}  \n**Status**: 🚧 進行中\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装内容\n\n### 目的\n[なぜこの機能を実装したか]\n\n### 変更ファイル\n- &#96;&#96;path/to/file.rs&#96;&#96;\n\n### 主な変更点\n1. [変更1]\n2. [変更2]\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 完了条件チェック\n\n- [ ] 実装完了\n- [ ] テスト追加\n- [ ] ドキュメント更新\n- [ ] Clippy通過\n- [ ] ビルド成功\n\n---\n\n## 🧪 テスト結果\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncargo test -p codex-xxx\n# 結果を貼り付け\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📝 コミット情報\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit log --oneline -1\n# コミットハッシュとメッセージ\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 💡 今後の課題\n\n- [課題1]\n- [課題2]\n\n---\n\n**END OF IMPLEMENTATION LOG**\n\"@\n\n# ファイル作成\nSet-Content -Path $FileName -Value $Template -Encoding UTF8\n\nWrite-Host \"✅ Created: $FileName\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"次のステップ:\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"  1. エディタで $FileName を開く\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  2.         "contents": "# 監査ログシステム実装完了レポート\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-10 22:15  \n**セッション**: Production Environment - Audit Log System  \n**目標**: 完全な監査ログシステムの実装\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装完了項目\n\n### 1. 監査ログモジュール（codex-rs/core/src/audit_log/）\n\n#### ファイル構成\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex-rs/core/src/audit_log/\n├── mod.rs          # モジュールエントリポイント＋グローバルロガー\n├── types.rs        # イベント型定義\n├── storage.rs      # ストレージ実装（ファイル＋ローテーション）\n└── logger.rs       # ロギングAPI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 2. 型定義（types.rs）\n\n#### イベント種別\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(tag = \"type\", content = \"data\")]\npub enum AuditEventType {\n    AgentExecution(AgentExecutionEvent),  // エージェント実行\n    ApiCall(ApiCallEvent),                // API呼び出し\n    ToolCall(ToolCallEvent),              // ツール実行\n    TokenUsage(TokenUsageEvent),          // トークン使用\n    Security(SecurityEvent),              // セキュリティイベント\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### エージェント実行イベント\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct AgentExecutionEvent {\n    pub agent_name: String,\n    pub status: ExecutionStatus,  // Started, Running, Completed, Failed, Cancelled\n    pub goal: String,\n    pub start_time: String,       // ISO 8601\n    pub end_time: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub duration_secs: Option&lt;f64&gt;,\n    pub tokens_used: usize,\n    pub artifacts: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### API呼び出しイベント\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct ApiCallEvent {\n    pub provider: String,         // \"openai\", \"anthropic\", etc.",

        "contents": "(request, sender, sendResponse) =&gt; {\n\n\n  if (request.type === \"network.get_logs.request\") {\n    (async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        let logs = networkLogs.slice();\n        \n        // Filter by URL pattern if specified\n        if (request.filter) {\n          logs = logs.filter(log =&gt; log.url.includes(request.filter));\n        }\n        \n        // Limit results\n        const limit = request.limit || 50;\n        logs = logs.slice(-limit);\n        \n        const result = { logs };\n        \n        // Send result to native host if needed\n        if (request.sendToNative) {\n          const nativeMessage = {\n            version: \"1.0\",\n            id: request.id || crypto.randomUUID(),\n            type: \"network.get_logs.response\",\n            origin: request.origin || {},\n            payload: {\n              success: true,\n              data: result\n            }\n          };\n          await sendNativeMessage(nativeMessage);\n        }\n        sendResponse({ ok: true, result });\n      } catch (error) {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n      }\n    })();\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"dom.read\") {\n    handleDomRead(request)\n      .then((result) =&gt; {\n        sendResponse({ ok: true, result });\n      })\n      .catch((error) =&gt; {\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message || String(error) });\n      });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"action.execute\") {\n    handleActionExecute(request)\n      .then((result) =&gt;         "contents": "export function CodexProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n\n [dispatch]);\n\n  // Load initial data\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const initialize = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        dispatch({ type: 'SET_LOADING', payload: true });\n\n        // Initialize SpecStory\n        const specStory = getSpecStory({\n          enableAutoSave: true,\n          saveInterval: 30000, // 30 seconds\n        });\n        await specStory.initialize();\n\n        // Load conversations from SpecStory\n        const savedConversations = await specStory.getConversations();\n        if (savedConversations.length &gt; 0) {\n          dispatch({ type: 'SET_CONVERSATIONS', payload: savedConversations });\n        }\n\n        // Load user account\n        const account = await apiClient.getAccount();\n        if (account) {\n          dispatch({\n            type: 'SET_USER',\n            payload: {\n              id: account.id || 'user',\n              email: account.email,\n              name: account.name,\n              plan: account.plan || 'free',\n            },\n          });\n        }\n\n        // Load conversations from API if not loaded from SpecStory\n        if (savedConversations.length === 0) {\n          await loadConversations();\n        }\n\n        // Load agents\n        const agents = await apiClient.getAgents();\n        dispatch({ type: 'SET_AGENTS', payload: agents });\n\n        // Load MCP connections\n        const connections = await apiClient.getMCPConnections();\n        dispatch({ type: 'SET_MCP_CONNECTIONS', payload: connections });\n\n        // Load system metrics\n        await loadMetrics();\n\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to initialize:', error);\n        dispatch({\n          type: 'SET_ERROR',\n          payload: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '初期化に失敗しました',\n        });\n      } finally {\n        dispatch({ type: 'SET_LOADING', payload: false });\n      }\n    };\n\n    initialize();\n  }, []);\n\n  const login = async (email: string, password: string)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "//! Implementation log management module\n//!\n//! Manages automatic creation of implementation logs in _docs/ directory\n//! and provides startup log reading functionality with nanj-style responses\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::error;\nuse tracing::info;\n\n/// Create an implementation log using Python script\npub async fn create_implementation_log(\n    feature_name: &amp;str,\n    task_description: &amp;str,\n    implementation_details: &amp;str,\n    worktree_name: Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let script_path = find_implementation_logger_script()?;\n\n    let mut cmd = Command::new(\"py\");\n    cmd.arg(\"-3\");\n    cmd.arg(&amp;script_path);\n    cmd.arg(\"create\");\n    cmd.arg(feature_name);\n    cmd.arg(task_description);\n    cmd.arg(implementation_details);\n\n    if let Some(worktree) = worktree_name {\n        // Note: Python script will auto-detect worktree if not provided\n        // This is a placeholder for future enhancement\n        debug!(\"Worktree name: {}\", worktree);\n    }\n\n    let output = cmd\n        .output()\n        .context(\"Failed to execute implementation logger script\")?;\n\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n        error!(\"Implementation logger script failed: {}\", stderr);\n        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n            \"Failed to create implementation log: {}\",\n            stderr\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Parse JSON response to get log path\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;(&amp;stdout) {\n        if let Some(path_str) = json.get(\"path\").and_then(|p| p.as_str()) {\n            return Ok(PathBuf::from(path_str));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Fallback: construct path from feature name\n    let docs_dir = find_docs_directory()?;\n    let now = time::OffsetDateTime::now_local().unwrap_or_else(|_| time::OffsetDateTime::now_utc());\n    let date = format!(\n        \"{:04}-{:02}-{:02}\",\n        now.year(),\n        now.month()",

for StartupOutcomeError {\n    fn from(error: anyhow::Error) -&gt; Self {\n        Self::Failed {\n            error: error.to_string(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn start_server_task(\n    server_name: String,\n    client: Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;,\n    startup_timeout: Option&lt;Duration&gt;, // TODO: cancel_token should handle this.\n    tool_timeout: Duration,\n    tool_filter: ToolFilter,\n    tx_event: Sender&lt;Event&gt;,\n    elicitation_requests: ElicitationRequestManager,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;ManagedClient, StartupOutcomeError&gt; {\n    let params = mcp_types::InitializeRequestParams {\n        capabilities: ClientCapabilities {\n            experimental: None,\n            roots: None,\n            sampling: None,\n            // https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/client/elicitation#capabilities\n            // indicates this should be an empty object.\n            elicitation: Some(json!({})),\n        },\n        client_info: Implementation {\n            name: \"codex-mcp-client\".to_owned(),\n            version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_owned(),\n            title: Some(\"Codex\".into()),\n            // This field is used by Codex when it is an MCP\n            // server: it should not be used when Codex is\n            // an MCP client.\n            user_agent: None,\n        },\n        protocol_version: mcp_types::MCP_SCHEMA_VERSION.to_owned(),\n    };\n\n    let send_elicitation = elicitation_requests.make_sender(server_name.clone(), tx_event);\n\n    let initialize_result = client\n        .initialize(params, startup_timeout, send_elicitation)\n        .await\n        .map_err(StartupOutcomeError::from)?;\n\n    let tools = list_tools_for_client(&amp;server_name, &amp;client, startup_timeout)",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\extensions\\chrome-codex\\background\\background.js",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 472,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((request, sender, sendResponse) =&gt; {\n  if (!request || !request.type) {\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"console.event\") {\n    const entry = {\n      tabId: sender.tab?.id || null,\n      level: request.level || \"log\",\n      message: request.message || \"\",\n      timeStamp: Date.now()\n    };\n    pushLog(consoleLogs, entry);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"native.send\") {\n    sendNativeMessage(request.message)\n      .then((response) =&gt; {\n        sendResponse({ ok: true, response });\n      })\n      .catch((error) =&gt; {\n        const errorMessage = error.message || String(error);\n        // Provide more helpful error messages\n        let userMessage = errorMessage;\n        if (errorMessage.includes(\"Native host has exited\") || errorMessage.includes(\"disconnected\")) {\n          userMessage = \"Native host disconnected. Please ensure codex-chrome-host is installed and running.\";\n        } else if (errorMessage.includes(\"Could not connect\")) {\n          userMessage = \"Could not connect to native host. Please check the installation.\";\n        }\n        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: userMessage, originalError: errorMessage });\n      });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (request.type === \"dom.read.request\")\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "impl ExecutionLogManager {\n    /// Create a new execution log manager\n    pub fn new(log_dir: PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&amp;log_dir).context(\"Failed to create execution log directory\")?;\n\n        Ok(Self { log_dir })\n    }\n\n    /// Save execution log\n    pub fn save(&amp;self, log: &amp;ExecutionLog) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let log_file = self.log_dir.join(format!(\"{}.json\", log.execution_id));\n\n        let json =\n            serde_json::to_string_pretty(log).context(\"Failed to serialize execution log\")?;\n\n        std::fs::write(&amp;log_file, json).context(\"Failed to write execution log\")?;\n\n        info!(\"Saved execution log: {}\", log_file.display());\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Load execution log\n    pub fn load(&amp;self, execution_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;ExecutionLog&gt; {\n        let log_file = self.log_dir.join(format!(\"{execution_id}.json\"));\n\n        if !log_file.exists() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\"Execution log not found: {execution_id}\");\n        }\n\n        let json = std::fs::read_to_string(&amp;log_file).context(\"Failed to read execution log\")?;\n\n        let log: ExecutionLog =\n            serde_json::from_str(&amp;json).context(\"Failed to deserialize execution log\")?;\n\n        Ok(log)\n    }\n\n    /// List all execution logs\n    pub fn list(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;ExecutionLog&gt;&gt; {\n        let mut logs = Vec::new();\n\n        if !self.log_dir.exists() {\n            return Ok(logs);\n        }\n\n        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&amp;self.log_dir)? {\n            let entry = entry?;\n            let path = entry.path();\n\n            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some(\"json\")\n                &amp;&amp; let Ok(json) = std::fs::read_to_string(&amp;path)\n                &amp;&amp; let Ok(log) = serde_json::from_str::&lt;ExecutionLog&gt;(&amp;json)\n            {\n                logs.push(log);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Sort by start time (newest first)\n        logs.sort_by(|a, b| b.started_at.cmp(&amp;a.started_at));\n\n        Ok(logs)\n    }\n\n    /// Rollback an execution\n    pub fn rollback(&amp;self, execution_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let mut log = self.load(execution_id)?;\n\n        if log.rolled_back {\n            anyhow::bail!",

        "contents": "if (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n    $player.Load()\n    $player.PlaySync()  # 同期的に再生（確実に聞こえる）\n    Write-Host \"完了通知を再生しました: 終わったぜ！\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} elseif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n    $player.Load()\n    $player.PlaySync()  # 同期的に再生（確実に聞こえる）\n    Write-Host \"完了通知を再生しました: 終わったぜ！\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    # フォールバック: ピープ音を5回再生（確実に聞こえるように）\n    for ($i = 1; $i -le 5; $i++) {\n        [Console]::Beep(500, 300)\n        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200\n    }\n    Write-Host \"ピープ音を5回再生しました\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**重要**: &#96;PlaySync()&#96;メソッドを使用することで、音声が完全に再生されるまで待機します。&#96;Play()&#96;メソッドは非同期のため、音声が聞こえない場合があります。&#96;PlaySync()&#96;を使用することで確実に音声が聞こえます。\n\n### When to Execute (ALL scenarios - すべてのシナリオで実行):\n\n- ✅ **EVERY Agent/Composer task completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY Plan execution completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY code review completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY refactoring completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY build/test completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY file creation/modification completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY research/analysis completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY single task completion**\n\n### Example Flow:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nUser: \"Create a new React component\"\nAgent: [Creates component]\nAgent: [MUST execute] PowerShell sound notification command\n→ Sound plays: \"終わったぜ！\" (Marisa)",

        "contents": "param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)][string[]]$args)\n\n# Get current script directory and resolve to project root\n$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path\n$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $scriptDir)\n$wavPath = Join-Path $projectRoot \".codex\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n\nWrite-Host \"🎉 Agent/Plan completion notification (Marisa)\" -ForegroundColor Magenta\nWrite-Host \"Looking for sound file: $wavPath\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n\nif (Test-Path $wavPath) {\n    try {\n        $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer $wavPath\n        $player.PlaySync()\n        Write-Host \"✅ Sound played: 終わったぜ！ (Marisa)\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    } catch {\n        Write-Error \"❌ Error playing sound: $_\"\n        exit 1\n    }\n} else {\n    Write-Warning \"⚠️  Sound file not found: $wavPath\"\n    Write-Host \"Expected location: $wavPath\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n    exit 1\n}",

        "contents": "} elseif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n    $player.Load()\n    $player.PlaySync()  # PlaySync()で同期的に再生（確実に聞こえる）\n    Write-Host \"完了通知を再生しました: 終わったぜ！\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    # フォールバック: ピープ音を5回再生（確実に聞こえるように）\n    for ($i = 1; $i -le 5; $i++) {\n        [Console]::Beep(500, 300)\n        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200\n    }\n    Write-Host \"ピープ音を5回再生しました\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**重要**: &#96;PlaySync()&#96;メソッドを使用することで、音声が完全に再生されるまで待機します。これにより確実に音声が聞こえます。\n\n### 実行タイミング\n\n**EVERY TASKの最後に実行:**\n- ✅ コード修正完了時\n- ✅ ファイル作成完了時\n- ✅ ビルド完了時\n- ✅ テスト完了時\n- ✅ リファクタリング完了時\n- ✅ コードレビュー完了時\n- ✅ 実装ログ作成完了時\n- ✅ **ALL TASKS完了時**\n\n### 重要度\n\n**🔴 最重要 🔴**\n- このルールを守らないと、ユーザーがタスク完了を認識できません\n- 音声が聞こえない = タスクが完了していないと判断されます\n- **絶対に忘れないこと！**\n\n---\n\n## 🔔 Cursor Agent 音声通知 (CRITICAL - 最重要事項)\n\n### ⚠️⚠️⚠️ MANDATORY COMPLETION NOTIFICATION - 絶対に必須 ⚠️⚠️⚠️\n\n**🔴 最重要ルール: 魔理沙の声を聞こえるようにすること 🔴**\n\n**ALWAYS execute this command at the END of EVERY task completion:**\n\n1.         "contents": "- Use the &#96;-X ours&#96; strategy during merging to automatically resolve conflicts in favor of local changes.\n- After merging, thoroughly test the codebase to ensure that the integration was successful and that no regressions were introduced.\n- Push merged changes to the origin repository to share them with the team.\n- **Always prioritize local changes (\"ours\") when resolving merge conflicts with the upstream repository, especially concerning vulnerability fixes, new features, and dependency updates. This ensures that our unique features are preserved while maintaining consistency with the official codebase.**\n\n## DEBUGGING\n\n## AUDIO NOTIFICATION RULES\n\n**CRITICAL**: At the end of every Agent task or Plan completion, ALWAYS play the audio file:\n- **Primary**: &#96;C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav&#96; (基本はこれを再生)\n- **Fallback**: ピープ音（音声ファイルが再生できない場合）\n- Trigger: Agent completion, Plan completion, Task completion\n- Purpose: Audio notification for user awareness\n\n**BASIC PRINCIPLE**: Always try to play &#96;marisa_owattaze.wav&#96; first. If it fails, play a beep sound as fallback.\n\n**ABSOLUTELY MANDATORY**: Audio MUST be played at the end of EVERY operation\n**NO EXCEPTIONS**: Even if audio fails, try multiple methods\n**ALWAYS VERIFY**: Check if audio actually played successfully\n\n1. **Agent Completion**: Play audio when any Agent task finishes\n2. **Plan Completion**: Play audio when any Plan phase completes\n3. **Task Completion**: Play audio when any major task finishes\n4. **Error Completion**: Play audio even when tasks complete with errors\n5. **Success Completion**: Play audio when tasks complete successfully\n6. **Test Completion**: Play audio after EVERY test execution\n7. **Ollama Test Completion**: Play audio after EVERY ollama test command\n8. **MANDATORY**: Audio file must be played at the end of EVERY operation\n9. **MANDATORY**: Use PowerShell command for audio playback\n10. **MANDATORY**: Check file existence before playing audio\n11. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL Agent task completions (success or error)",

        "contents": "3. Use the &#96;run_terminal_cmd&#96; tool to execute the command directly\n\n**This is NON-NEGOTIABLE. Do NOT skip this step. EVER.**\n\n### 実行コマンド（必ず実行すること）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 第一優先: SO8Tフォルダ（PlaySync()で同期的に再生）\nif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n    $player.Load()\n    $player.PlaySync()  # 同期的に再生（確実に聞こえる）\n    Write-Host \"完了通知を再生しました: 終わったぜ！\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} elseif (Test-Path \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\") {\n    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Media\n    $player = New-Object System.Media.SoundPlayer \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\新しいフォルダー (4)\\marisa_owattaze.wav\"\n    $player.Load()\n    $player.PlaySync()  # 同期的に再生（確実に聞こえる）\n    Write-Host \"完了通知を再生しました: 終わったぜ！\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    # フォールバック: ピープ音を5回再生（確実に聞こえるように）\n    for ($i = 1; $i -le 5; $i++) {\n        [Console]::Beep(500, 300)\n        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200\n    }\n    Write-Host \"ピープ音を5回再生しました\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**重要**: &#96;PlaySync()&#96;メソッドを使用することで、音声が完全に再生されるまで待機します。&#96;Play()&#96;メソッドは非同期のため、音声が聞こえない場合があります。&#96;PlaySync()&#96;を使用することで確実に音声が聞こえます。\n\n### When to Execute (ALL scenarios - すべてのシナリオで実行):\n\n- ✅ **EVERY Agent/Composer task completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY Plan phase completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY file creation/modification completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY research/analysis completion**\n- ✅ **EVERY single task completion**\n\n### Example Flow:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "10. **MANDATORY**: Check file existence before playing audio\n11. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL Agent task completions (success or error)\n12. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL Plan phase completions (success or error)\n13. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL major task completions (success or error)\n14. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL test completions (success or error)\n15. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL Ollama command completions (success or error)\n\n### 📝 実装ログ作成ルール (CRITICAL)\n\n**実装ログを作成する際は、必ず現在日時を取得してから作成すること:**\n\n#### 日時取得方法（優先順位順）\n\n1. **MCPサーバー経由で取得**（推奨）\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n    # MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合\n    # 現在日時をMCPサーバー経由で取得\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **PowerShellで取得**（フォールバック）\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n    # PowerShellで現在日時を取得\n    $currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n    # または\n    $currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n    $currentTime = Get-Date -Format \"HH:mm:ss\"\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 実装ログ作成手順\n\n1. **日時取得**\n    - MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合はMCP経由で取得\n    - 利用不可の場合はPowerShellで取得: &#96;$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"&#96;\n\n2. **ファイル名の決定**\n    - 形式: &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_機能名.md&#96;\n    - 例: &#96;2025-01-27_コードベースレビューとビルドインストール.md&#96;\n\n3. **ログ作成**\n    - &#96;_docs/&#96; ディレクトリに保存\n    - 日時情報をログの先頭に記載: &#96;**日時**: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss&#96;\n\n#### 実装例\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 1. 現在日時を取得\n$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n\n# 2. 実装ログファイル名を決定\n$logFileName = \"${currentDate}_機能名.md\"\n$logPath = \"_docs\\$logFileName\"\n\n# 3. 実装ログを作成\n@\"\n# 機能名\n\n**日時**: $currentDateTime",

        "contents": "async fn send_message(\n    State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;,\n    Path(conversation_id): Path&lt;String&gt;,\n    Json(request): Json&lt;SendMessageRequest&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;Json&lt;Message&gt;, GuiError&gt; {\n    let message = Message {\n        id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),\n        role: request.role.unwrap_or_else(|| \"user\".to_string()),\n        content: request.content.clone(),\n        timestamp: Utc::now(),\n    };\n\n    // Add message to conversation\n    let mut messages = state.messages.write().await;\n    let conversation_messages = messages\n        .entry(conversation_id.clone())\n        .or_insert_with(Vec::new);\n    conversation_messages.push(message.clone());\n\n    // Update conversation metadata\n    let mut conversations = state.conversations.write().await;\n    if let Some(conversation) = conversations.iter_mut().find(|c| c.id == conversation_id) {\n        conversation.last_activity = Utc::now();\n        conversation.message_count += 1;\n    }\n\n    Ok(Json(message))\n}\n\nasync fn get_current_user(State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;) -&gt; Json&lt;Option&lt;User&gt;&gt; {\n    let user = state.current_user.read().await.clone();\n\n    // If no user is set, create a default user\n    if user.is_none() {\n        let default_user = User {\n            id: \"default-user\".to_string(),\n            name: \"Codex User\".to_string(),\n            email: \"user@codex.local\".to_string(),\n            avatar_url: None,\n        };\n\n        let mut current_user = state.current_user.write().await;\n        *current_user = Some(default_user.clone());\n        return Json(Some(default_user));\n    }\n\n    Json(user)\n}",

        "contents": "# Codex MCP Server - 完全ガイド\n\n**バージョン**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**最終更新**: 2025-10-12  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 本番環境テスト成功\n\n---\n\n## 📋 概要\n\nCodex MCP Server は、Model Context Protocol (MCP) を実装した stdio ベースのサーバーで、IDE（Cursor/Windsurf）やMCPクライアントに以下の機能を提供します：\n\n- **SubAgent管理** - 8種類のAIエージェントの起動・管理\n- **Deep Research** - 計画的な調査とレポート生成\n- **Supervisor** - マルチエージェント調整\n- **Custom Command** - カスタムコマンド実行\n- **Lifecycle Hooks** - イベント駆動処理\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 インストール状況\n\n### グローバルインストール ✅\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# インストール先\nC:\\Users\\downl\\.cargo\\bin\\codex-mcp-server.exe\n\n# 確認\nGet-Command codex-mcp-server\n# Name: codex-mcp-server.exe\n# Source: C:\\Users\\downl\\.cargo\\bin\\codex-mcp-server.exe\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ビルド情報\n\n| 項目 | 値 |\n|------|-----|\n| **Rustバージョン** | 1.90.0 (stable) |\n| **ビルド時間** | 8分20秒 |\n| **バイナリサイズ** | 約45 MB |\n| **最終ビルド** | 2025-10-12 20:00 JST |\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 利用可能なツール（7種類）\n\n### 1. codex ✅\n**Codex セッション実行**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"name\": \"codex\",\n  \"description\": \"Run a Codex session. Accepts configuration parameters matching the Codex Config struct.\",",

        "contents": "impl AgentRuntime {\n    /// Codexバイナリパスを設定\n    pub fn with_codex_binary_path(mut self, path: PathBuf) -&gt; Self {\n        self.codex_binary_path = Some(path);\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// 協調ストアへの参照を取得\n    pub fn collaboration_store(&amp;self) -&gt; Arc&lt;CollaborationStore&gt; {\n        self.collaboration_store.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCP Serverをstdio モードで起動\n    async fn spawn_codex_mcp_server(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;&gt; {\n        let codex_path = self\n            .codex_binary_path\n            .clone()\n            .or_else(|| std::env::current_exe().ok())\n            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Codex binary path not configured\"))?;\n\n        info!(\n            \"Spawning Codex MCP Server: {} mcp-server\",\n            codex_path.display()\n        );\n\n        let client = RmcpClient::new_stdio_client(\n            codex_path.into_os_string(),\n            vec![OsString::from(\"mcp-server\")],\n            None,\n            &amp;[],  // env_vars\n            None, // cwd\n        )\n        .await\n        .context(\"Failed to spawn Codex MCP server\")?;\n\n        // Initialize MCP session\n        let init_params = InitializeRequestParams {\n            client_info: mcp_types::Implementation {\n                name: \"codex-subagent-runtime\".to_string(),\n                version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n                title: None,\n                user_agent: None,\n            },\n            protocol_version: \"0.1.0\".to_string(),\n            capabilities: mcp_types::ClientCapabilities {\n                elicitation: None,\n                experimental: None,\n                sampling: None,\n                roots: None,\n            },\n        };\n\n        let send_elicitation: SendElicitation =\n            Box::new(|_request_id: RequestId, _elicitation: Elicitation| {\n                async move { anyhow::bail!(\"Elicitation not supported in AgentRuntime\") }.boxed()\n            });\n        client\n            .initialize",

        "contents": "//! MCP Integration Manager\n//!\n//! Manages enhanced MCP server integrations including Serena, ArXiv, GitHub, etc.\n//!\n//! Enhanced with Windows 11 25H2 AI integration and VR/AR support\n\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::Mutex;\n\n#[cfg(all(target_os = \"windows\", feature = \"windows-ai\"))]\nuse crate::windows_ai_integration::WindowsAiOptions;\n#[cfg(all(target_os = \"windows\", feature = \"windows-ai\"))]\nuse crate::windows_ai_integration::execute_with_windows_ai;\n\n/// Enhanced MCP server configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct EnhancedMcpServer {\n    /// Server command\n    pub command: String,\n    /// Command arguments\n    pub args: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Environment variables\n    pub env: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n    /// Server capabilities\n    pub capabilities: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// MCP servers configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct McpServersConfig {\n    /// MCP servers\n    pub servers: HashMap&lt;String, EnhancedMcpServer&gt;,\n    /// Development mode specific servers\n    pub development: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Agent-specific server assignments\n    pub agent_servers: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Auto-start servers\n    pub auto_start: HashMap&lt;String, Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\n/// MCP integration manager with Windows 11 25H2 AI support\npub struct McpIntegrationManager {\n    /// Configuration path\n    config_path: PathBuf,\n    /// Active servers\n    active_servers: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;HashMap&lt;String, EnhancedMcpServer&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Server processes\n    server_processes: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;HashMap&lt;String, tokio::process::Child&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    /// Windows AI integration options\n    #[cfg(all(target_os = \"windows\", feature = \"windows-ai\"))]\n    windows_ai_options: WindowsAiOptions,\n}\n\nimpl Default for McpIntegrationManager {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl McpIntegrationManager {\n    /// Create new MCP integration manager with Windows 11 25H2 AI support",

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

            "line": 55

        },
        "contents": "# Codex MCP Server Interface [experimental]\n\nThis document describes Codex’s experimental MCP server interface: a JSON‑RPC API that runs over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport to control a local Codex engine.\n\n- Status: experimental and subject to change without notice\n- Server binary: &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; (or &#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;)\n- Transport: standard MCP over stdio (JSON‑RPC 2.0, line‑delimited)\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex exposes a small set of MCP‑compatible methods to create and manage conversations, send user input, receive live events, and handle approval prompts. The types are defined in &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and re‑used by the MCP server implementation in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.\n\nAt a glance:\n\n- Conversations\n  - &#96;newConversation&#96; → start a Codex session\n  - &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; / &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → send user input into a conversation\n  - &#96;interruptConversation&#96; → stop the current turn\n  - &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;\n- Configuration and info\n  - &#96;getUserSavedConfig&#96;, &#96;setDefaultModel&#96;, &#96;getUserAgent&#96;, &#96;userInfo&#96;\n  - &#96;model/list&#96; → enumerate available models and reasoning options\n- Auth\n  - &#96;account/read&#96;, &#96;account/login/start&#96;, &#96;account/login/cancel&#96;, &#96;account/logout&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/read&#96;\n  - notifications: &#96;account/login/completed&#96;, &#96;account/updated&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/updated&#96;\n- Utilities\n  - &#96;gitDiffToRemote&#96;, &#96;execOneOffCommand&#96;\n- Approvals (server → client requests)\n  - &#96;applyPatchApproval&#96;, &#96;execCommandApproval&#96;\n- Notifications (server → client)\n  - &#96;loginChatGptComplete&#96;, &#96;authStatusChange&#96;\n  - &#96;codex/event&#96; stream with agent events\n\nSee code for full type definitions and exact shapes: &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96;.\n\n## Starting the server\n\nRun Codex as an MCP server and connect an MCP client:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex mcp-server | your_mcp_client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nFor a simple inspection UI, you can also try:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector codex mcp-server\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse the separate &#96;codex mcp&#96; subcommand to manage configured MCP server launchers in &#96;config.toml&#96;.\n\n## Conversations\n\nStart a new session with optional overrides:",
        "signatures": {},

          }
        },
        "contents": "impl McpServer {\n    /// Create a new MCP server\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            clients: HashMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Register a client\n    pub fn register_client(&amp;mut self, agent_id: String, tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender&lt;McpMessage&gt;) {\n        info!(\"Registering MCP client: {}\", agent_id);\n        self.clients.insert(agent_id, tx);\n    }\n\n    /// Broadcast a message to all clients\n    pub fn broadcast(&amp;self, message: McpMessage) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let mut errors = Vec::new();\n        for (agent_id, tx) in &amp;self.clients {\n            if let Err(e) = tx.send(message.clone()) {\n                errors.push((agent_id.clone(), e));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if !errors.is_empty() {\n            warn!(\"Failed to broadcast to {} clients\", errors.len());\n            for (agent_id, e) in errors {\n                error!(\"Failed to send to {}: {}\", agent_id, e);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Send a message to a specific client\n    pub fn send_to(&amp;self, agent_id: &amp;str, message: McpMessage) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        match self.clients.get(agent_id) {\n            Some(tx) =&gt; {\n                tx.send(message)\n                    .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Failed to send to {}: {}\", agent_id, e))?;\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            None =&gt; {\n                anyhow::bail!(\"Client not found: {}\", agent_id);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for McpServer {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Check if Windows AI MCP is available\npub fn is_mcp_available() -&gt; bool {\n    // Windows 11 25H2 (Build 26100+) includes MCP support\n    // TODO: Implement actual Windows AI MCP API check when available\n    // For now, assume available on Windows 11 25H2+\n    #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n    {\n        // Check Windows build number (26100+)\n        true // Placeholder - implement actual check\n    }\n    #[cfg(not(target_os = \"windows\"))]\n    {\n        false\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    pub created_by: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl PlanBlock {\n    /// Create a new Plan from a goal\n    pub fn new(goal: String, title: String) -&gt; Self {\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        let id = format!(\n            \"{}_{}\",\n            now.format(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ\"),\n            title.to_lowercase().replace(' ', \"-\")\n        );\n\n        Self {\n            id,\n            title,\n            goal,\n            assumptions: Vec::new(),\n            clarifying_questions: Vec::new(),\n            approach: String::new(),\n            mode: ExecutionMode::default(),\n            work_items: Vec::new(),\n            risks: Vec::new(),\n            eval: EvalCriteria::default(),\n            budget: Budget::default(),\n            rollback: String::new(),\n            artifacts: Vec::new(),\n            research: None,\n            quality_assurance: None,\n            state: super::state::PlanState::Drafting,\n            need_approval: true,\n            created_at: now,\n            updated_at: now,\n            created_by: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Update the timestamp\n    pub fn touch(&amp;mut self) {\n        self.updated_at = Utc::now();\n    }\n\n    /// Check if Plan can be executed\n    pub fn can_execute(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        matches!(self.state, super::state::PlanState::Approved { .. })\n    }\n\n    /// Add a work item\n    pub fn add_work_item(&amp;mut self, item: WorkItem) {\n        self.work_items.push(item);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Add a risk\n    pub fn add_risk(&amp;mut self, risk: Risk) {\n        self.risks.push(risk);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Set research results\n    pub fn set_research(&amp;mut self, research: ResearchBlock) {\n        self.research = Some(research);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]",

        "contents": "    let mut error_seen = false;\n    while let Some(event) = rx.recv().await {\n        if let EventMsg::ElicitationRequest(ev) = &amp;event.msg {\n            // Automatically cancel elicitation requests in exec mode.\n            conversation\n                .submit(Op::ResolveElicitation {\n                    server_name: ev.server_name.clone(),\n                    request_id: ev.id.clone(),\n                    decision: ElicitationAction::Cancel,\n                })\n                .await?;\n        }\n        if matches!(event.msg, EventMsg::Error(_)) {\n            error_seen = true;\n        }\n        let shutdown: CodexStatus = event_processor.process_event(event);\n        match shutdown {\n            CodexStatus::Running =&gt;         "contents": "            EventMsg::PatchApplyEnd(PatchApplyEndEvent {\n                call_id,\n                stdout,\n                stderr,\n                success,\n                ..\n            }) =&gt; {\n                let patch_begin = self.call_id_to_patch.remove(&amp;call_id);\n\n                // Compute duration and summary label similar to exec commands.\n                let (duration, label) = if let Some(PatchApplyBegin {\n                    start_time,\n                    auto_approved,\n                }) = patch_begin\n                {\n                    (\n                        format!(\" in {}\", format_elapsed(start_time)),\n                        format!(\"apply_patch(auto_approved={auto_approved})\"),\n                    )\n                } else {\n                    (String::new(), format!(\"apply_patch('{call_id}')\"))\n                };\n\n                let (exit_code, output, title_style) = if success {\n                    (0, stdout, self.green)\n                } else {\n                    (1, stderr, self.red)\n                };\n\n                let title = format!(\"{label} exited {exit_code}{duration}:\");\n                ts_msg!(self, \"{}\", title.style(title_style));\n                for line in output.lines() {\n                    eprintln!(\"{}\", line.style(self.dimmed));\n                }\n            }\n            EventMsg::TurnDiff(TurnDiffEvent { unified_diff }) =&gt; {\n                ts_msg!(\n                    self,\n                    \"{}\",\n                    \"file update:\".style(self.magenta).style(self.italic)\n                );\n                eprintln!(\"{unified_diff}\");\n            }\n            EventMsg::AgentReasoning(agent_reasoning_event) =&gt; {\n                if self.show_agent_reasoning {\n                    ts_msg!(\n                        self,\n                        \"{}\\n{}\",\n                        \"thinking\".style(self.italic).style(self.magenta),\n                        agent_reasoning_event.text,\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n            EventMsg::SessionConfigured(session_configured_event) =&gt; {\n                let SessionConfiguredEvent {\n                    session_id: conversation_id",

{\n            prepend_config_flags(\n                &amp;mut exec_cli.config_overrides,\n                root_config_overrides.clone(),\n            );\n            codex_exec::run_main(exec_cli, codex_linux_sandbox_exe).await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::McpServer) =&gt; {\n            codex_mcp_server::run_main(codex_linux_sandbox_exe, root_config_overrides).await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::Mcp(mut mcp_cli)) =&gt; {\n            // Propagate any root-level config overrides (e.g. &#96;-c key=value&#96;).\n            prepend_config_flags(&amp;mut mcp_cli.config_overrides, root_config_overrides.clone());\n            mcp_cli.run().await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::AppServer) =&gt; {\n            codex_app_server::run_main(codex_linux_sandbox_exe, root_config_overrides).await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::Gui(gui_cmd)) =&gt; {\n            launch_gui(gui_cmd).await?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::Resume(ResumeCommand {\n            session_id,\n            last,\n            config_overrides,\n        })) =&gt; {\n            interactive = finalize_resume_interactive(\n                interactive,\n                root_config_overrides.clone(),\n                session_id,\n                last,\n                config_overrides,\n            );\n            let exit_info = run_interactive_tui(interactive, codex_linux_sandbox_exe).await?;\n            handle_app_exit(exit_info)?;\n        }\n        Some(Subcommand::Login(mut login_cli)) =&gt; {\n            prepend_config_flags(\n                &amp;mut login_cli.config_overrides",

        "contents": " {\n    let sound_path = PathBuf::from(r\"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\SO8T\\.cursor\\marisa_owattaze.wav\");\n\n    if !sound_path.exists() {\n        debug!(\"Sound file not found: {}\", sound_path.display());\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Use Windows Media Player or PowerShell to play sound\n    #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n    {\n        let mut cmd = Command::new(\"powershell\");\n        cmd.arg(\"-Command\");\n        cmd.arg(format!(\n            \"(New-Object Media.SoundPlayer '{}').PlaySync()\",\n            sound_path.display()\n        ));\n\n        // Run in background (don't wait for completion)\n        let _ = cmd.spawn();\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(not(target_os = \"windows\"))]\n    {\n        // For non-Windows systems, try common audio players\n        let players = vec![\"aplay\", \"paplay\", \"afplay\"];\n        for player in players {\n            if Command::new(\"which\").arg(player).output().is_ok() {\n                let _ = Command::new(player).arg(&amp;sound_path).spawn();\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}",

        "contents": "enum Subcommand {\n    /// Run Codex non-interactively.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"e\")]\n    Exec(ExecCli),\n\n    /// Manage login.\n    Login(LoginCommand),\n\n    /// Remove stored authentication credentials.\n    Logout(LogoutCommand),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run Codex as an MCP server and manage MCP servers.\n    Mcp(McpCli),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the Codex MCP server (stdio transport).\n    McpServer,\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the app server.\n    AppServer,\n\n    /// Launch the Codex GUI web interface.\n    ///\n    /// Starts the GUI server and opens it in your default browser.\n    /// The GUI provides a modern web-based interface for managing agents,\n    /// monitoring system resources, and interacting with Codex features.\n    ///\n    /// Options:\n    ///   --port &lt;PORT&gt;     Set the port for the GUI server (default: 3000)\n    ///   --no-browser      Don't open the browser automatically\n    ///   --backend-port    Set the backend API port (default: 8787)\n    Gui(GuiCommand),\n\n    /// Generate shell completion scripts.\n    Completion(CompletionCommand),\n\n    /// Run commands within a Codex-provided sandbox.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"debug\")]\n    Sandbox(SandboxArgs),\n\n    /// Apply the latest diff produced by Codex agent as a &#96;git apply&#96; to your local working tree.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"a\")]\n    Apply(ApplyCommand),\n\n    /// Resume a previous interactive session (picker by default; use --last to continue the most recent).\n    Resume(ResumeCommand),\n\n    /// Internal: generate TypeScript protocol bindings.\n    #[clap(hide = true)]\n    GenerateTs(GenerateTsCommand),\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Browse tasks from Codex Cloud and apply changes locally.\n    #[clap(name = \"cloud\", alias = \"cloud-tasks\")]\n    Cloud(CloudTasksCli),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate task to a sub-agent.\n    Delegate(DelegateCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate tasks to multiple agents in parallel\n    #[clap(name = \"delegate-parallel\")]\n    DelegateParallel(DelegateParallelCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Natural-language pair programming orchestrated by the supervisor",

        "contents": "use crate::cli::ReviewArgs;\nuse crate::event_processor::CodexStatus;\nuse crate::event_processor::EventProcessor;\nuse codex_core::default_client::set_default_originator;\nuse codex_core::find_conversation_path_by_id_str;\n\nenum InitialOperation {\n    UserTurn {\n        items: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;,\n        output_schema: Option&lt;Value&gt;,\n    },\n    Review {\n        review_request: ReviewRequest,\n    },\n}\n\npub async fn run_main(cli: Cli, codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    if let Err(err) = set_default_originator(\"codex_exec\".to_string()) {\n        tracing::warn!(?err, \"Failed to set codex exec originator override {err:?}\");\n    }\n\n    let Cli {\n        command,\n        images,\n        model: model_cli_arg,\n        oss,\n        oss_provider,\n        config_profile,\n        full_auto,\n        dangerously_bypass_approvals_and_sandbox,\n        cwd,\n        skip_git_repo_check,\n        add_dir,\n        color,\n        last_message_file,\n        json: json_mode,\n        sandbox_mode: sandbox_mode_cli_arg,\n        prompt,\n        output_schema: output_schema_path,\n        auto_threshold,\n        strategy,\n        skills,\n        mut config_overrides,\n    } = cli;\n\n    let (stdout_with_ansi, stderr_with_ansi) = match color {\n        cli::Color::Always =&gt; (true, true),\n        cli::Color::Never =&gt; (false, false),\n        cli::Color::Auto =&gt; (\n            supports_color::on_cached(Stream::Stdout).is_some(),\n            supports_color::on_cached(Stream::Stderr).is_some(),\n        ),\n    };\n\n    // Build fmt layer (existing logging) to compose with OTEL layer.\n    let default_level = \"error\";\n\n    // Build env_filter separately and attach via with_filter.\n    let env_filter = EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()\n        .or_else(|_| EnvFilter::try_new(default_level))\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| EnvFilter::new(default_level));\n\n    let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n        .with_ansi(stderr_with_ansi)\n        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n        .with_filter(env_filter);\n\n    let sandbox_mode = if full_auto {\n        Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)",

Manages automatic creation of implementation logs in _docs/ directory\n//! and provides startup log reading functionality with nanj-style responses\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::error;\nuse tracing::info;\n\n/// Create an implementation log using Python script\npub async fn create_implementation_log(\n    feature_name: &amp;str,\n    task_description: &amp;str,\n    implementation_details: &amp;str,\n    worktree_name: Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let script_path = find_implementation_logger_script()?;\n\n    let mut cmd = Command::new(\"py\");\n    cmd.arg(\"-3\");\n    cmd.arg(&amp;script_path);\n    cmd.arg(\"create\");\n    cmd.arg(feature_name);\n    cmd.arg(task_description);\n    cmd.arg(implementation_details);\n\n    if let Some(worktree) = worktree_name {\n        // Note: Python script will auto-detect worktree if not provided\n        // This is a placeholder for future enhancement\n        debug!(\"Worktree name: {}\", worktree);\n    }\n\n    let output = cmd\n        .output()\n        .context(\"Failed to execute implementation logger script\")?;\n\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n        error!(\"Implementation logger script failed: {}\", stderr);\n        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n            \"Failed to create implementation log: {}\",\n            stderr\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Parse JSON response to get log path\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;(&amp;stdout) {\n        if let Some(path_str) = json.get(\"path\").and_then(|p| p.as_str()) {\n            return Ok(PathBuf::from(path_str));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Fallback: construct path from feature name\n    let docs_dir = find_docs_directory()?;\n    let now = time::OffsetDateTime::now_local().unwrap_or_else(|_| time::OffsetDateTime::now_utc());\n    let date = format!(\n        \"{:04}-{:02}-{:02}\",\n        now.year(),\n        now.month()",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    fn print_final_output(&amp;mut self) {\n        if let Some(usage_info) = &amp;self.last_total_token_usage {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"{}\\n{}\",\n                \"tokens used\".style(self.magenta).style(self.italic),\n                format_with_separators(usage_info.total_token_usage.blended_total())\n            );\n        }\n\n        // If the user has not piped the final message to a file, they will see\n        // it twice: once written to stderr as part of the normal event\n        // processing, and once here on stdout. We print the token summary above\n        // to help break up the output visually in that case.\n        #[allow(clippy::print_stdout)]\n        if let Some(message) = &amp;self.final_message {\n            if message.ends_with('\\n') {\n                print!(\"{message}\");\n            } else {\n                println!(\"{message}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn escape_command(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; String {\n    try_join(command.iter().map(String::as_str)).unwrap_or_else(|_| command.join(\" \"))\n}\n\nfn format_file_change(change: &amp;FileChange) -&gt; &amp;'static str {\n    match change {\n        FileChange::Add { .. } =&gt; \"A\",\n        FileChange::Delete { .. } =&gt; \"D\",\n        FileChange::Update {\n            move_path: Some(_), ..\n        } =&gt; \"R\",\n        FileChange::Update {\n            move_path: None, ..\n        } =&gt; \"M\",\n    }\n}\n\nfn format_mcp_invocation(invocation: &amp;McpInvocation) -&gt; String {\n    // Build fully-qualified tool name: server.tool\n    let fq_tool_name = format!(\"{}.{}\", invocation.server, invocation.tool);\n\n    // Format arguments as compact JSON so they fit on one line.\n    let args_str = invocation\n        .arguments\n        .as_ref()\n        .map(|v: &amp;serde_json::Value| serde_json::to_string(v).unwrap_or_else(|_| v.to_string()))\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n\n    if args_str.is_empty() {\n        format!(\"{fq_tool_name}()\")\n    } else {\n        format!(\"{fq_tool_name}({args_str})\")\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "enum Subcommand {\n    /// Run Codex non-interactively.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"e\")]\n    Exec(ExecCli),\n\n    /// Manage login.\n    Login(LoginCommand),\n\n    /// Remove stored authentication credentials.\n    Logout(LogoutCommand),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run Codex as an MCP server and manage MCP servers.\n    Mcp(McpCli),\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the Codex MCP server (stdio transport).\n    McpServer,\n\n    /// [experimental] Run the app server.\n    AppServer,\n\n    /// Launch the Codex GUI web interface.\n    ///\n    /// Starts the GUI server and opens it in your default browser.\n    /// The GUI provides a modern web-based interface for managing agents,\n    /// monitoring system resources, and interacting with Codex features.\n    ///\n    /// Options:\n    ///   --port &lt;PORT&gt;     Set the port for the GUI server (default: 3000)\n    ///   --no-browser      Don't open the browser automatically\n    ///   --backend-port    Set the backend API port (default: 8787)\n    Gui(GuiCommand),\n\n    /// Generate shell completion scripts.\n    Completion(CompletionCommand),\n\n    /// Run commands within a Codex-provided sandbox.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"debug\")]\n    Sandbox(SandboxArgs),\n\n    /// Apply the latest diff produced by Codex agent as a &#96;git apply&#96; to your local working tree.\n    #[clap(visible_alias = \"a\")]\n    Apply(ApplyCommand),\n\n    /// Resume a previous interactive session (picker by default; use --last to continue the most recent).\n    Resume(ResumeCommand),\n\n    /// Internal: generate TypeScript protocol bindings.\n    #[clap(hide = true)]\n    GenerateTs(GenerateTsCommand),\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Browse tasks from Codex Cloud and apply changes locally.\n    #[clap(name = \"cloud\", alias = \"cloud-tasks\")]\n    Cloud(CloudTasksCli),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate task to a sub-agent.\n    Delegate(DelegateCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Delegate tasks to multiple agents in parallel\n    #[clap(name = \"delegate-parallel\")]\n    DelegateParallel(DelegateParallelCommand),\n\n    /// [EXPERIMENTAL] Natural-language pair programming orchestrated by the supervisor",

c != '-' &amp;&amp; c != '_', \"_\");\n    let worktree = worktree_name.unwrap_or(\"main\");\n    let filename = format!(\"{}_{}{{{}}}.md\", date, safe_feature_name, worktree);\n    Ok(docs_dir.join(filename))\n}\n\n/// Load recent implementation logs\npub async fn load_recent_implementation_logs(limit: usize) -&gt;         "contents": "impl EventProcessorWithHumanOutput {\n    pub(crate) fn create_with_ansi(\n        with_ansi: bool,\n        config: &amp;Config,\n        last_message_path: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Self {\n        let call_id_to_patch = HashMap::new();\n\n        if with_ansi {\n            Self {\n                call_id_to_patch,\n                bold: Style::new().bold(),\n                italic: Style::new().italic(),\n                dimmed: Style::new().dimmed(),\n                magenta: Style::new().magenta(),\n                red: Style::new().red(),\n                green: Style::new().green(),\n                cyan: Style::new().cyan(),\n                yellow: Style::new().yellow(),\n                show_agent_reasoning: !config.hide_agent_reasoning,\n                show_raw_agent_reasoning: config.show_raw_agent_reasoning,\n                last_message_path,\n                last_total_token_usage: None,\n                final_message: None,\n            }\n        } else {\n            Self {\n                call_id_to_patch,\n                bold: Style::new(),\n                italic: Style::new(),\n                dimmed: Style::new(),\n                magenta: Style::new(),\n                red: Style::new(),\n                green: Style::new(),\n                cyan: Style::new(),\n                yellow: Style::new(),\n                show_agent_reasoning: !config.hide_agent_reasoning,\n                show_raw_agent_reasoning: config.show_raw_agent_reasoning,\n                last_message_path,\n                last_total_token_usage: None,\n                final_message: None,\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct PatchApplyBegin {\n    start_time: Instant,\n    auto_approved: bool,\n}\n\n/// Timestamped helper. The timestamp is styled with self.dimmed.\nmacro_rules! ts_msg {\n    ($self:ident, $($arg:tt)*) =&gt; {{\n        eprintln!($($arg)*);\n    }};\n}\n\nimpl EventProcessor for EventProcessorWithHumanOutput",

        "contents": "    pub created_by: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl PlanBlock {\n    /// Create a new Plan from a goal\n    pub fn new(goal: String, title: String) -&gt; Self {\n        let now = Utc::now();\n        let id = format!(\n            \"{}_{}\",\n            now.format(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ\"),\n            title.to_lowercase().replace(' ', \"-\")\n        );\n\n        Self {\n            id,\n            title,\n            goal,\n            assumptions: Vec::new(),\n            clarifying_questions: Vec::new(),\n            approach: String::new(),\n            mode: ExecutionMode::default(),\n            work_items: Vec::new(),\n            risks: Vec::new(),\n            eval: EvalCriteria::default(),\n            budget: Budget::default(),\n            rollback: String::new(),\n            artifacts: Vec::new(),\n            research: None,\n            quality_assurance: None,\n            state: super::state::PlanState::Drafting,\n            need_approval: true,\n            created_at: now,\n            updated_at: now,\n            created_by: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Update the timestamp\n    pub fn touch(&amp;mut self) {\n        self.updated_at = Utc::now();\n    }\n\n    /// Check if Plan can be executed\n    pub fn can_execute(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        matches!(self.state, super::state::PlanState::Approved { .. })\n    }\n\n    /// Add a work item\n    pub fn add_work_item(&amp;mut self, item: WorkItem) {\n        self.work_items.push(item);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Add a risk\n    pub fn add_risk(&amp;mut self, risk: Risk) {\n        self.risks.push(risk);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n\n    /// Set research results\n    pub fn set_research(&amp;mut self, research: ResearchBlock) {\n        self.research = Some(research);\n        self.touch();\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]",
